Hi All

Please see below and attached feedback on actions from yesterday’s meeting.

Regulatory Confirmation 

	*	The angle sensor requirement applies in Europe and Israel but is not mandatory for the UK, avoiding unnecessary procurement for UK vehicles.



I checked with Stuart and although the angle sensor is not a requirement for the UK market, we are going to have the angle sensors on F-Series as standard for the UK market. So we will have to work these into the recommended parts list for P700.

Digital Process Improvements 

	*	Proposal from ITUK to develop an online portal for tracking technical and parts queries submitted to IML, replacing the current email-based process. 
	*	The concept will be proposed to Japan and evaluated together with IT to improve transparency and response times.

 

ISZE presented the development of a portal system at the 2024 EU Aftersales conference (refer attached and screenshot below). Has there been any progress on this portal since it was presented in 2024? 



 



 

*	Engine & Cab Parts 

Please see attached “VIN List 23_07_2026”. Is it possible for our colleagues at IML to populate the complete engine, cab with electrics and cab without electrics part numbers and send back to us? This would reduce the amount of time required to quote for cabs and engines in the future.

 

James is going to send the forecast information for dealer sales tomorrow.

 

Kind regards
